instruction: Look at freecad_task-3_input.step in FreeCAD. Re-machine the annular flange with multiple features while preserving the 130 mm outside diameter and 14 mm thickness. Enlarge the center bore to diameter 36 mm. Cut eight vertical through bolt holes of diameter 8 mm on a 50 mm bolt-circle radius, with the first on +X and the rest every 45 degrees. Add a concentric top counterbore of diameter 18 mm and depth 5 mm to each bolt hole. Cut a straight radial keyway on the +X side that is 12 mm wide along Y, extends from X=15 mm to the outside rim, and passes through the full thickness. Finally add two shallow blind dowel holes of diameter 5 mm and depth 7 mm at radius 38 mm and angles 22.5 degrees and 202.5 degrees. Export /home/user/Desktop/freecad_task-3_output.step. Complete the work only through the FreeCAD GUI; external scripts are forbidden.
